# Problem 1
```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The penguins dataset shows data on penguin species, island, bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass, sex, and year. 

There are `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables. 

The mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)`mm.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

penguin_scatterplot = ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + 
  geom_point()

penguin_scatterplot

ggsave("penguin_scatterplot.png", plot = penguin_scatterplot)

```

# Problem 2
```{r}
set.seed(1234)

problem2_df = tibble(
  vec_numeric = rnorm(10),
  vec_logical = vec_numeric > 0,
  vec_char = c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "i", "j"),
  vec_factor = factor(c("low", "medium", "high", "low", "medium", "high", "low", "medium", "high", "low"))
)

problem2_df
```

```{r}
mean(pull(problem2_df, vec_numeric))
mean(pull(problem2_df, vec_logical))
mean(pull(problem2_df, vec_char))
mean(pull(problem2_df, vec_factor))
```

The mean works for the random sample and logical vector. But it does not work for character vector and factor vector because they are not numeric or logical variables.

```{r, results = "hide", warning = FALSE}
as.numeric(pull(problem2_df, vec_logical))
as.numeric(pull(problem2_df, vec_char))
as.numeric(pull(problem2_df, vec_factor))
```

The logical and factor vector can be converted to numeric values. Because in logical vector, true is treated as 1 and false is treated as 0. For factor vectors, medium is converted to 3, low to 2, and high to 1. Character vector cannot be converted.
